breaks.why: SQL injection risk in native wpdb's MySQL literal escaping, fixed by speedyspec-server#134; remove this entry once it merges. A value with a backslash before a quote (`k\'`) reaches MySQL as `'k\''`, so the INSERT fails and add_metadata() returns false.
